run_main_people_counting: run the main function to count people in polygon zones using YOLO on a video
load_zones_config: load polygon zone configurations from a JSON file into a list of NumPy arrays
initiate_annotators: initiate polygon zones and annotators with optimal line thickness and text scale for a given resolution
detect_people: detect people in a video frame using a YOLO model with configurable confidence and IoU thresholds
annotate_frame: annotate a video frame with zone boundaries and bounding boxes for detections in each zone
